# `returning-deinitialized-view`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a returned view whose backing container is deinitialized by a deferred
cleanup during return.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The caller receives a slice or view after its storage has already been
destroyed.

## When it fires

It applies when the returned binding, backing container, and deferred `deinit`
are all directly connected.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn items(allocator: std.mem.Allocator) []u8 {
    var list = std.ArrayList(u8).empty;
    defer list.deinit(allocator);
    return list.items;
}
```
